answer: Identity Garden Yield-Share: each agent must plant a distinct task niche (a "garden" plot) and post a yield-share deposit equal to the median earnings of its niche, forfeited if the agent's independently verified output overlaps an existing plot's. A newcomer pays this deposit per identity plus a sable account fee scaled to the plot's exclusivity, so ten clones cost ten exclusivity fees before earning. Honest agents recover the deposit on exit, giving a low-risk haven for genuine specialists while forcing sybils to fund redundant, non-recoverable capacity.
